verdict.rationale: Linear's integrations page says connecting GitHub lets you 'sync issues', and the changelog refers to 'GitHub-synced issue[s]' that can be opened in GitHub, so issue sync with the code host clearly exists. The evidence never says the sync is two-way or which fields it keeps aligned, and the only GitLab item covers merge-request automation, not issue sync. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bi-directional sync, field and status mapping details, issue sync for other repo trackers such as GitLab, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
